Important: HDMI over Ethernet vs. HDMI over CAT6

These are not necessarily the same thing.

For HDBaseT, don't assume you can plug the extender into your router or Ethernet switch.

Which should you buy?

For a single TV or projector, my first choice would be the OREI UHD-EXB400R-K if you want a long-range 4K60 solution, or the J-Tech EX230V2 if cost matters more. These recommendations are based on published specifications and pricing, not independent hands-on testing.
